tactics:
induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b l' =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ i => exact ih (l' := l') (i := i) (by simp at h ⊢; omega)
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.zipWith]
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> simp at h <;> cases i <;> simp_all
